salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves deterministic Glade-local value-object construction and fields. It excludes hosted Salesforce parity and org-context URL behavior.

source.content: Address address = new Address(); address.street = '12 Lake Road'; address.city = 'Port Alsworth'; address.state = 'Alaska'; address.statecode = 'AK'; address.postalcode = '99653'; address.country = 'United States'; address.countrycode = 'US'; address.geocodeaccuracy = 'Zip'; System.assertEquals('12 Lake Road', address.street); System.assertEquals('Port Alsworth', address.city); System.assertEquals('Alaska', address.state); System.assertEquals('AK', address.statecode); System.assertEquals('99653', address.postalcode); System.assertEquals('United States', address.country); System.assertEquals('US', address.countrycode); System.assertEquals('Zip', address.geocodeaccuracy); Location location = new Location(); location.latitude = 37.7749; location.longitude = -122.4194; System.assertEquals(37.7749, location.latitude); System.assertEquals(-122.4194, location.longitude); SelectOption pair = new SelectOption('value', 'Label'); System.assertEquals('value', pair.getValue()); System.assertEquals('Label', pair.getLabel()); SelectOption triple = new SelectOption('value2', 'Label 2', true); System.assertEquals('value2', triple.getValue()); System.assertEquals('Label 2', triple.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(true, triple.getDisabled()); URL https = new URL('https://user:pass@example.test/path'); System.assertEquals('user:pass@example.test', https.getAuthority()); System.assertEquals('example.test', https.getHost()); URL ftp = new URL('ftp://files.example.test/pub/readme.txt'); System.assertEquals(21, ftp.getDefaultPort());
